build_slow_to_fast_tokenizer: build a converter that transforms a slow HuggingFace tokenizer into a fast tokenizer using the SLOW_TO_FAST_CONVERTERS mapping
create_sentencepiece_extractor: create a SentencePieceExtractor that parses a SentencePiece model proto file and extracts vocab and merges for BPE or Unigram tokenizers
convert_bert_tokenizer: convert a BertTokenizer slow instance into a fast WordPiece tokenizer with BertNormalizer and BertPreTokenizer
convert_spm_tokenizer: convert a SentencePiece-based slow tokenizer into a fast tokenizer with Metaspace pre-tokenizer and decoder
extract_tiktoken_vocab_merges: extract vocab and merges from a tiktoken BPE model file and build a fast BPE tokenizer
